title: Fetch and the Browser Client
description: Connecting a browser client to an API: fetching data, handling HTTP errors and ProblemDetail responses, fixing CORS, where tokens should live, calling a Spring Boot API, environment settings for the API address, and testing a plain function with Vitest.
